news.title: Penalty denies New Zealand in opening game at FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup
news.lede: A stoppage-time penalty by Japan has denied New Zealand their first point at this year’s FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup in Poland. New Zealand and Japan were tied 1-1 at the end of normal time at Stadion Miejski ŁKS Łódź when the Asian champions were awarded a penalty. The spot kick was struck home by Miyu Matsunaga, giving her a double for the match. After a scoreless first half, Matsunaga gave Japan the lead four minutes into the second spell.

news.title: Infantino reiterates intention to run for fourth term as Fifa boss
news.lede: Gianni Infantino, the head of world football's governing body Fifa, on Sunday redeclared his intention to continue until 2031 as the sport's most powerful executive despite calls for his resignation over his botched plan to sell a stake in Fifa competitions to private investors. "The Fifa president announced in April that he will stand for re-election in 2027," a Fifa spokesperson said. "Of course, nothing has changed. Mr Infantino will be standing for re-election."

news.title: Philippines women’s national football team secures qualification for 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup
news.lede: News On AIR | March 19, 2026 1:13 PM. The Philippines women’s national football team have secured qualification for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup after defeating the Uzbekistan women’s national football team 2-0 in a Women’s Asian Cup play-in match on the Gold Coast today. Angela Beard delivered a standout performance, opening the scoring early in the second half after earlier missed opportunities. She found the net in the 47th minute with a well-taken strike into the roof of the goal.
